full_name: Deirdre Bloome | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Radcliffe Institute Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Deirdre Bloome is a PhD candidate in sociology and social policy at Harvard University. Her research interests include economic and racial stratification, social mobility, family demography, policy, and statistical methodology.
